headline: Indian stock market sees high volatility as Sensex swings sharply while Jio Platforms IPO sets record

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices topping $113 per barrel triggered market pressure and selloffs.
Sharp fall from intraday high levels as Sensex plunged over 1,200 points.
Weak Q2 earnings in real estate sector added downward pressure on key stocks.
BSE-listed market capitalization slipped below Rs 450 lakh crore amid broad market weakness.
whatHappening: Nifty tested around 22,400 levels after crashing from the day's high.
Jio Platforms IPO created global history by receiving over 1 crore applications.
Godrej Properties reported a 62% decline in Q2FY27 net profit, causing its stock to drop 6%.
CSB Bank reported a 14% rise in Q2 profit, supporting recovery in select financial counters.
summary: Indian markets witnessed extreme intraday volatility with Sensex crashing over 1,200 points from day's high before attempting a partial recovery. While high oil prices and weak real estate Q2 earnings hurt market sentiment, the historic success of the Jio Platforms IPO provided a major highlight. CSB Bank traded higher following a 14% profit increase in Q2.
